benefits.name: 3% Cash Back on Chosen Spend Category
benefits.description: Unlimited 3% Cash Back in one spend category selected by the cardholder from a fixed menu.
benefits.terms: Cardholder selects the category and may switch it each calendar quarter. Defaults to dining at account opening. No cap on 3% earnings. Superstore and warehouse club purchases earn 1% regardless of the selected category. Cash equivalents, money orders, and gift card purchases/reloads are ineligible.

benefits.name: 2% Cash Back on Chosen Spend Category
benefits.description: Unlimited 2% Cash Back in a second spend category selected by the cardholder from a fixed menu.
benefits.terms: Cardholder selects a second category, distinct from the 3% category, and may switch it each calendar quarter. Defaults to grocery stores at account opening. No cap on 2% earnings. Superstore and warehouse club purchases earn 1% regardless of the selected category.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage against damage or theft of an eligible cell phone when the monthly mobile bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Requires paying the monthly wireless bill with the card. Visa benefit; see the Guide to Benefits for coverage limits and deductible.

benefits.name: ID Navigator Powered by NortonLifeLock
benefits.description: Identity theft monitoring and restoration support for cardholders.

benefits.name: Visa Roadside Dispatch
benefits.description: Pay-per-use roadside assistance referral service available 24/7.
benefits.terms: Service is arranged at a set fee per dispatch; the fee is not waived by the card.

benefits.name: Emergency Card Replacement
benefits.description: Emergency replacement of a lost or stolen card while traveling.

earningRates.terms: Unlimited 1% Cash Back on all purchases outside the two selected spend categories. Superstore and warehouse club purchases always earn this base rate.
